native_effects.method: Every decoded native frame, small RGB pictures; textured negative correlation and inverse residual. Black borders excluded. Half-open native frame intervals; no easing or sound inferred.
limitations: Candidates need inspection; motion/occlusion can hide an inversion or split its span.
An inverted first frame has no clean predecessor and cannot be established.
Not a general shot-boundary, wipe, blur or transition-direction classifier.

review.reviewer: Codex gpt-6.1-sol; sampled private full frames and native boundary sheets
limits: Native-boundary and half-second pages are not an exhaustive audiovisual teardown.
Subjects are visual annotations. Relationship to exact words, source licensing and origin unestablished.
Unreviewed container tail excluded; full-runtime semantic share intentionally null.
repairs inversion and graphic-card cuts only; complete classes, caption truth, subject scoring and sound attribution remain unmeasured.
